name: bracemark-share
description: The native halves the bracemark-expo share sheet needs, one per host (docs/share-sheet.md). Android: the translucent ShareActivity hosting the RN share sheet, plus the BracemarkShare close() module. iOS: BracemarkShareKeyboard, which reports the keyboard's frame inside the share extension, where RN's own reads it through RCTKeyWindow() and gets zero. Local Expo module, autolinked from apps/bracemark-expo/modules into both the app and the extension target.
